d:
Lok aastha ka mahaparv chhath ko lekar sanatniyon men kaphi utsah hai. is parv men har ek vyakti ki yah chahat hoti hai ki uski sahbhagita sunishchit ho. ise dekhte hue hajaribag men yuvaon ki tim ke dvara 301 vratiyon ko matr 11 rupye men pujan ki 21 samagri uplabdh karaee ja rahi hai.
